probes.free_sql_transaction_participation: verified on SQLite 3.5.308: two repositories share the platform UoW; abandon hides both writes and complete persists both
probes.sql_sugar_transaction_participation: verified on SQLite 5.1.4.214 with explicit scoped client assembly; two repositories share the platform UoW; abandon hides both writes and complete persists both
probes.sql_sugar_client_lifetime: defect: production module registers a singleton SqlSugarClient; two scopes resolve the same instance
probes.free_sql_cancellation: pre-cancelled token surfaces as System.Exception wrapping TaskCanceledException; cancellation source is lost; in-flight cancellation not probed
probes.sql_sugar_cancellation: pre-cancelled token is ignored because repository entries do not pass the token; in-flight cancellation not probed
probes.module_sqlite_runnability: FreeSql and SqlSugar modules hardcode SqlServer; module-level SQLite behavior cannot be exercised until S3 unifies assembly

imusthavetenant.current_default: EF generated filter uses host-null => all tenants; base repository filters only when DataFilterState enables TenantFilter and a tenant is present

datafilter_imultitenant.current_default: EF generated filter uses host-null => all; FreeSql/SqlSugar register no filter when the current tenant is null

tenant_marker_freeze.target: Host ordinary reads must not implicitly gain an all-tenant view; optional IMultiTenant host reads only null shared rows; mandatory-tenant writes must validate persisted ownership. Tightening requires real consumers and migration notes in S3.
